title: T1584.003 — Compromise Infrastructure - Virtual Private Server
subtitle: Watch the full story: an attacker steals a small hosting customer's cloud account, spins up a VPS inside it, and uses that machine to scan, phish, and relay C2 traffic - while...
aria: Animated diagram: an attacker takes over a cloud account and its virtual private server, uses the machine to scan and phish a target organization, and a SOC detects and blocks the activity. A written step-by-step version follows below.

nodes.label: Sensitive data

steps.caption: The attacker phishes a small hosting customer and harvests the password or session cookie for their cloud account.
steps.defender: a phishing report arrives, and soon a login from a strange country shows up in cloud audit logs.
